newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-FREE STATE WIN TOSS, BAT AGAINST GRIQUAS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-FREE STATE WIN TOSS, BAT AGAINST GRIQUAS.

text.p: Free State captain Louis Wilkinson won the toss and decided to bat first on the opening day of the four-day Supersport Series cricket match against Griqualand West at Kimberley Country Club on Friday.
Griqualand West - Mickey Arthur (captain), Martyn Gidley, Pieter Barnard, Willie Dry, Ralph Koster, Cedric English, Brett Benkenstein, Wendell Bossinger, Adri Swanepoel, Vaughn Walsh, Garth Roe.

Free State - Deon Jordaan, Gerhardus Liebenberg, Boeta Dippenaar, Kosie Venter, Louis Wilkinson (captain), Chris Craven, Franklyn Stephenson, Herman Bakkes, Bradley Player, Philip Radley, Kleinboet van Rensburg.
